teaching_pattern.requirement: State in ordinary language what problem the reader is trying to solve.
Identify the actors, sources, resources, boundaries, commitments, losses, or competing actions.
Give at least one classified numerical, operational, economic, ecological, physical, historical, observed, or counterexample. It is mandatory.
When the feature corrects or extends an earlier idea, show concretely what information or behavior the simpler model loses.
Explain what produces the result before introducing compressed terminology.
Apply mathematical_explanation_order without replacement or reordering.
State positively and precisely what EBU can represent, calculate, preserve, distinguish, reject, or test.
Explain why the capability matters to recursion, transactions, allocation, topology, measurement, or future testing.
Classify the claim and state assumptions, domains, tolerances, and scope.
Give a counterexample or inapplicability condition and state what must not be inferred.

mathematical_explanation_order_integrity.relationship: The ten-step teaching pattern surrounds rather than replaces the accepted eight-step mathematical order; teaching step 6 embeds all eight steps exactly.

example_provenance_rules.hypothetical: Label explicitly and forbid presentation as empirical validation.

editorial_balance_rules: State the established result and positive EBU capability before assumptions, limits, and nonclaims.
Do not present established mathematical tools as EBU inventions.
Identify the capability gained by the EBU combination or adaptation.
Do not universalize a conditional result.
Do not weaken a proved conditional result into a vague possibility.
Do not obscure the contribution with front-loaded disclaimers.
Avoid unnecessarily diminishing phrases such as EBU merely uses, only an analogy, or nothing more than.
Avoid promotional claims unsupported by authority or evidence.
Distinguish originality of a mathematical tool from potential significance of the complete EBU synthesis.
pedagogical_authority.shared_explanation_rule: Closely related features may share an explanation only if each feature is individually traceable and the complete explanation appears at its first substantial use.

foundation_decisions.name: ECONOMIC_ATOM
foundation_decisions.decision: An EBU economic atom is limiting differential participation in a declared extent coordinate, never a smallest positive transaction or divided actor.

foundation_decisions.name: DECLARED_EXTENT_DIVISIBILITY
foundation_decisions.decision: Divisibility attaches to a declared nonatomic quantity, time, process or route extent, or frozen dimensionless participation; identity, acceptance, receipts, and modes remain indivisible.

foundation_decisions.name: CLOSED_EXTENT_REGISTRY
foundation_decisions.decision: The initial registry contains exactly physical time, process or route extent, typed carrier quantity, and dimensionless participation.

foundation_decisions.name: REPARAMETERIZATION
foundation_decisions.decision: Positive affine unit changes are automatic; nonlinear positive C1 changes require a witness; singular, non-C1, reversing, or non-invertible changes inherit no claim.

foundation_decisions.name: SEPARATE_GENERATOR_ROLES
foundation_decisions.decision: Quantity-participation and complete augmented-state transformation generators are distinct and require a declared constitutive or incidence link.

foundation_decisions.name: LOSS_EFFICIENCY_SCALING
foundation_decisions.decision: Every limit names denominator, units, coordinate, regime, fixed costs, and non-overlapping account; L(h) approaching zero alone does not establish unit efficiency.

foundation_decisions.name: HYBRID_ACTION
foundation_decisions.decision: A discrete activation or mode jump precedes or follows a declared within-mode continuous flow under an exact no-duplication order.

foundation_decisions.name: AUGMENTED_STATE_SUFFICIENCY
foundation_decisions.decision: Every variable affecting future behavior under an admitted history must be explicit; no universal minimal state is claimed.

foundation_decisions.name: REQUEST_TO_SETTLEMENT_LIFECYCLE
foundation_decisions.decision: Request, permission or reservation, quote, acceptance, execution, measurement, physical receipt, causal assessment, and settlement are ordered and non-equivalent.

foundation_decisions.name: HISTORY_WIDE_BOUNDARY_EQUIVALENCE
foundation_decisions.decision: Exact recursive replacement requires history-wide observable behavior plus separate burden, conservation, account, and settlement preservation.

foundation_decisions.name: FEASIBILITY_FIRST_OBJECTIVE_GRAMMAR
foundation_decisions.decision: No universal scalar exists; enforce feasibility first, then use one declared scalar or a declared typed-vector comparison with horizon, uncertainty, existence, and tie rules.

foundation_decisions.name: ALLOCATION_SETTLEMENT_BOUNDARY
foundation_decisions.decision: KKT, shadow prices, and optional scalar decompositions end before causal identification and institutional settlement.

foundation_decisions.name: FINITE_INTERACTION_FOUNDATION
foundation_decisions.decision: Exact finite interaction uses full-subset Mobius inversion, explicitly includes I_empty=E(empty), normalizes v(S)=E(S)-E(empty) when desired, and refuses missing or inadmissible subsets.

foundation_decisions.name: LOCAL_AND_ORDER_WITNESSES
foundation_decisions.decision: Mixed-marginal and commutator witnesses are optional, local, coordinate-, unit-, domain-, regularity-, mode-, tolerance-, sign-, and orientation-qualified, and never automatic causal, physical-propagation, or physical-phase-interference claims.

foundation_decisions.name: SHARED_CONSTRAINTS_AND_TOPOLOGY
foundation_decisions.decision: Shared constraints belong at the lowest complete common boundary when one exists; DAGs and federations require a declared factor boundary or proven-equivalent distributed protocol; structural interaction, active interaction, physical transport, and institutional constraint topologies remain distinct.

foundation_decisions.name: BOUNDARY_INVARIANCE_AND_CLAIM_LIMITS
foundation_decisions.decision: All-subset boundary equality, including empty-baseline information and identical state, boundary, policy, horizon, history, flow/jump, burden, and process-account semantics, preserves exposed coefficients but only external or quotient topology; it does not establish causality, settlement entitlement, physical propagation, or physical phase interference. Wave and phase-interference research is outside the active and future programme and creates no book, framework, implementation, experimental, or stage obligation.

extent_registry.generator_unit_rule: state unit per process or path unit

extent_registry.unit_rule: dimensionless on [0,1] tied to one frozen bundle

interaction_contract.truncation_residual: R_gt_k(S)=E(S)-E(empty)-sum_{nonempty R subseteq S, |R|<=k} I_R=sum_{R subseteq S, |R|>k} I_R
interaction_contract.refusal: If any required subset is inadmissible or meaningless, the Boolean-lattice coefficient is undefined and validation refuses it. A separately authorized feasible-set poset must supply its own proven Mobius function; it may not inherit the Boolean alternating-sign formula.

interaction_kind_distinctions.finite_set: Full-subset Mobius coefficient under one frozen subset protocol.
interaction_kind_distinctions.same_baseline_nonadditivity: N_G=E_G-sum_i E_i^(0) under its accepted same-baseline comparison.
interaction_kind_distinctions.serial_comparator: I_{G|pi}=E_G-E_seq,pi under one declared serial order comparator.

mixed_marginal.finite_difference: Delta_i Delta_j E(q)=E(q+delta_i e_i+delta_j e_j)-E(q+delta_i e_i)-E(q+delta_j e_j)+E(q)
mixed_marginal.integral_relation: Delta_i Delta_j E(q)=integral_0^delta_i integral_0^delta_j partial_ij E(q+s e_i+t e_j) dt ds

commutator.nonclaim: A commutator is a local order-sensitivity witness, not physical propagation, physical phase interference, or causality; a zero bracket at one point does not prove neighborhood commutativity.

interaction_contract.shared_constraint_rule: Resolve a shared constraint at the lowest complete common boundary whose state and authority contain the complete constraint.
interaction_contract.dag_or_federation_rule: When no unique lowest complete common boundary exists, require a declared factor boundary or a distributed protocol proven equivalent.
interaction_contract.pairwise_zero_rule: Zero pair coefficients do not imply full separability or absence of a higher-order hyperedge.

boundary_invariance.required_equalities: E_H(R)=E_P(R) for every exposed subset R, including the empty-baseline information.
boundary_invariance.result: All exposed Mobius coefficients agree by linearity.
boundary_invariance.encapsulation_limit: Only declared external or quotient interaction structure is preserved unless internal identities and factors remain exposed.

parallel_action_typology_programme.claim_boundary: Positive or negative parallel-action interaction is not physical phase interference. Graph reachability, oscillation, complex eigenvalues, higher-order interaction, and commutators do not prove physical propagation or physical phase interference.

wave_and_phase_interference_programme.rule: The package assigns no wave or physical phase-interference model, test, discrimination lesson, implementation, experiment, framework work, stage, or book. Defensive nonclaims remain mandatory and are not a research programme.

electrical_voltage_programme.rule: Electrical-voltage terminology and analogy are excluded rather than retained as an open problem. Their only trace is the removal disposition required by S14 and the excluded-electrical-analogy scope check AFV-I30.

nonclaims.text: No smallest positive transaction is established.
No universal action divisibility is established.
A generator does not replace finite transactions, receipts, acceptance, or settlement.
Vanishing loss alone does not establish unit efficiency.
No ordinary exponential reconstructs every generator.
An initial marginal does not generally equal the finite outcome.
KKT conditions alone do not establish existence, global optimality, uniqueness, causality, or settlement; a shadow price is not automatically a settlement price.
Aumann-Shapley does not select quantities, prove physics or causality, or create entitlement.
Snapshot equality is not exact recursive equivalence.
There is no universal scalar group objective.
Zero pair interactions do not imply full separability.

An interaction coefficient or share does not prove causality, entitlement, settlement, physical propagation, or physical phase interference; positive or negative parallel-action interaction is not physical phase interference, and a commutator does not prove it.

Graph reachability is not proof of physical propagation; a generator, oscillation, complex eigenvalues, higher-order interaction, or commutator does not prove physical propagation or physical phase interference.
V is a declared EBU burden and is not thermodynamic entropy.
No broad originality or universal-priority claim is made.
No implementation, book edit, scientific execution, interpretation, or publication is authorized.
